model.md.overview.shop.back-office.payme.name: Charge once
model.md.overview.shop.back-office.payme.body: Checkout retries the same request. The order service treats a repeated checkout key as the order it already created, so a retry never charges twice.

model.yaml.Parts.actor.name: actor
model.yaml.Parts.actor.description: Someone outside the system who uses it. Drawn wherever they meet it.

model.yaml.Parts.external.name: external
model.yaml.Parts.external.description: A system nobody here runs. The shop meets it only at its edge.

model.yaml.Parts.page.name: page
model.yaml.Parts.page.description: A screen a customer uses. It shows something and asks for something, over HTTP.

model.yaml.Parts.service.name: service
model.yaml.Parts.service.description: Runs on its own, owns its data and speaks to others only through its ports. Every service names the team that runs it: check reports one that does not.

model.yaml.Parts.store.name: store
model.yaml.Parts.store.description: Keeps many records of one type, drawn as a table on its card. Records are values, never blocks.

model.yaml.Records.ledger.name: Ledger
model.yaml.Records.ledger.description: A store of orders: many records of one type, drawn as a table on its card.

model.yaml.Records.line.name: Line
model.yaml.Records.line.description: One product on an order, and how many.

model.yaml.Records.order.name: Order
model.yaml.Records.order.description: A customer's request, and the lines on it.

model.yaml.Records.order.1.name: place
model.yaml.Records.order.1.description: Takes a customer's lines and gives back the order they make.

model.yaml.Records.order.order-states.name: Order states
model.yaml.Records.order.order-states.description: A state machine, the Order record's lifecycle, ranked by where its transitions point. Each transition is named by the event that fires it.

model.yaml.Records.payment.name: Payment
model.yaml.Records.payment.description: A charge taken against an order.

model.yaml.overview.name: Overview
model.yaml.overview.description: The shop in its world: who uses it and what it leans on. Open Shop to go inside; every diagram here is one side of it.

model.yaml.overview.1.name: One shop, seen from every side: open Shop for its parts, and a part for its own diagram. Every part is a usage of a definition in Parts or Records.

model.yaml.overview.shop.name: Shop
model.yaml.overview.shop.description: The shop itself, one region a side: what customers reach, what runs behind it, the records it keeps, and how it runs.

model.yaml.overview.shop.back-office.ord.name: Orders
model.yaml.overview.shop.back-office.ord.description: Keeps every order and tells the rest of the shop when one is placed.

model.yaml.overview.shop.back-office.ord.name: Runbook
model.yaml.overview.shop.back-office.ord.body:
# When orders stop flowing

Check the **relay** first. See the [outbox pattern](https://microservices.io/patterns/data/transactional-outbox.html).

| signal | threshold | page |
|---|---|---|
| outbox rows | 10 000 | yes |
| relay lag | 60 s | no |

model.yaml.overview.shop.back-office.ord.name: Release notes
model.yaml.overview.shop.back-office.ord.body: v2 of the orders API: the checkout key is required.

model.yaml.overview.shop.back-office.pay.name: Payments
model.yaml.overview.shop.back-office.pay.description: Takes money for an order, once, and says whether it was taken. Open it for how a charge is retried.

model.yaml.overview.shop.back-office.pay.name: A retried checkout repeats the same key, so a retry never charges twice.
Incident summary
model.yaml.overview.shop.back-office.pay.body: Checkout was slow for twenty minutes while the card processor timed out. The breaker opened, the fallback queued charges, and every queued charge was taken once the processor came back.

model.yaml.overview.shop.back-office.pay.name: Payment retry
model.yaml.overview.shop.back-office.pay.description: A flowchart, one of Payments' behaviours. It starts and ends at its marks; a decision's lines say where each answer goes.

model.yaml.overview.shop.customer-facing.name: Storefront
model.yaml.overview.shop.customer-facing.description: An internal diagram: what the storefront is made of. Its pages meet through typed ports; its own ports sit on its walls.

model.yaml.overview.shop.data.1-model.name: Model
model.yaml.overview.shop.data.1-model.description: The records as classes — fields, then behaviours — joined by the associations stored between them, each end saying how many and in what role. Order status is a type, so it draws no card of its own.

model.yaml.overview.shop.data.2-schema.name: Schema
model.yaml.overview.shop.data.2-schema.description: The records as an entity relationship diagram — columns and keys — the same associations drawn as crow's feet.

model.yaml.overview.shop.how-it-runs.1-c.name: Checkout saga
model.yaml.overview.shop.how-it-runs.1-c.description: A sequence: who talks to whom, in what order. Each lifeline is a reference to the part it stands for, so it is the same Gateway, Storefront and Payments the shop is made of.

model.yaml.overview.shop.how-it-runs.2-f.name: Fulfilment
model.yaml.overview.shop.how-it-runs.2-f.description: A swimlane: who does what, in which phase. Each lane is a reference to the service that does the work.

model.yaml.overview.shop.how-it-runs.2-f.name: Pick items
model.yaml.overview.shop.how-it-runs.2-f.body: Stock is taken off the shelf.

model.yaml.overview.shop.how-it-runs.2-f.name: Book carrier
model.yaml.overview.shop.how-it-runs.2-f.body: Shipping books a pickup in the carrier's terms.

model.yaml.overview.shop.how-it-runs.3-d.name: Deployment
model.yaml.overview.shop.how-it-runs.3-d.description: Where the shop runs. Groups nest, each a dashed box round its members with a note tied beside it; a grid lays environments under their headers.

model.yaml.overview.shop.how-it-runs.4-e.name: Estate
model.yaml.overview.shop.how-it-runs.4-e.description: A treemap: where the weight is. Each tile is as large as the service it stands for holds, gathered by the shop's regions.

model.yaml.overview.shop.how-it-runs.5-d.name: Dashboard
model.yaml.overview.shop.how-it-runs.5-d.description: What the shop looks like from the operations floor: a picture card, drawn from its source.
